explanation.headline: FDA's records trace our supply to a plant classified OAI 217 days before the shortage posting

sentences.text: FDA posted the propofol shortage on 2020-04-10 and it has remained on the list for 78 months as of 2026-10-21.
Inspection 1106244 at Pfizer Healthcare India Private Limited ended 2019-09-06 and was classified OAI, with the classification letter dated 2020-05-25, 217 days before the shortage posting.
A Warning Letter was issued to the same plant on 2020-03-25, 16 days before the shortage posting.
Corvale General holds propofol from that plant (NDC 00409469924) with 143.95 units on hand.
Corvale General also holds propofol from Pfizer Laboratories Div Pfizer Inc (NDC 00069020910) with 102.23 units on hand.
P&T has approved these two NDCs as interchangeable same-product alternates.
The top-ranked action is to transfer 35 units from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside, which would give Corvale Lakeside 14 days on hand while Corvale General retains two weeks.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.

Q-688586.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%propofol%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%propofol%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-f9e857.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('28d7ba00-f824-4e55-139a-03f509c099db', 'fee3bd4a-ade3-41fa-839a-48e9af69bcf4') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-3de070.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%propofol%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-449cc4.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%propofol%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-0ccdff.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%propofol%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%inject%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-13f05d.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('3008316085', '3002631703', '3003708554', '3002880938') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-3dac55.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('3008316085', '3002631703', '3003708554', '3002880938') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-48383a.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('3008316085', '3002631703', '3003708554') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('pfizer india', 'fresenius kabi uppsala', 'fresenius kabi', 'fresenius kabi austria')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-09c578.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('pfizer india', 'fresenius kabi uppsala', 'fresenius kabi', 'fresenius kabi austria', 'pfizer div pfizer', 'hospira', 'heritage d b a avet') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%propofol%' ORDER BY initiation_date
